note: Round-71 TrendAI Zero Day Initiative (ZDI) disclosure process. S106 is the ZDI 'About Us' page as served: the vendor-agnostic acquisition programme's disclosure process (validation, private vendor sharing, the time-bound coordination window, the full advisory after a patch, the limited advisory when no fix arrives), the vendor-coordination numbers (a 120-day standard window, 30/60/90 days for failed or incomplete patches, a permissive escalation to a limited public advisory if a vendor fails to respond within 15 business days of first contact) and the researcher flow (validate -> formal monetary offer -> payment -> vendor coordination -> credit or anonymity). It is the acquisition-programme ground F13 (platform severity ladders and reward scales), S005 (Project Zero's 90-day policy), S004 (CERT/CC's own policy) and F11/F38 (the ISO 29147/30111 division of labour) do not hold; it is NOT a platform payout ladder, NOT a coordinator's statutory timeline and NOT any single advisory instance.

quotes.quote: the world's largest vendor-agnostic vulnerability disclosure program
A vendor-agnostic bug bounty program where researchers are financially incentivized to submit vulnerabilities.
TrendAI™ ZDI's disclosure process is designed to ensure that vulnerabilities are handled responsibly, and not resold, redistributed, or censored.
Vendors are given a standard coordination window of 120 days under TrendAI™ ZDI's disclosure policy.
TrendAI™ ZDI shortens the window to 30, 60, or 90 days, depending on multiple factors.
If a vendor fails to respond within 15 business days of first contact, TrendAI™ ZDI may escalate to a limited public advisory to protect users.
TrendAI™ ZDI may publish a limited advisory to protect the broader public while withholding information that could enable exploitation.
When the vendor releases a patch, TrendAI™ ZDI publishes a full advisory.
Once your report is received, TrendAI™ ZDI validates the vulnerability, confirms its severity, and issues a formal monetary offer.
TrendAI™ ZDI guarantees that your work will not disappear into a backlog or remain undisclosed due to vendor inaction.
You can choose to be publicly credited in the advisory, remain anonymous, or use a pseudonym.
TrendAI™ ZDI provides the vendor with a complete technical dossier, which includes proof of concept, reproducible steps, severity assessment
If a vendor refuses to patch or remains unresponsive, TrendAI™ ZDI may publish a full or limited advisory
TrendAI™ ZDI imposes no limit on the number of reports researchers can submit
